summary: Blue Owl Capital Corporation II (OBDC II), a Maryland BDC, filed an 8-K on October 20, 2026 disclosing that its board declared a $0.62 per share return-of-capital distribution on October 15, 2026, equal to 7.5% of December 31, 2025 NAV, payable on or before October 21, 2026 to holders of record October 20, 2026. Cumulative returns of capital now total $4.16 per share, or 50.3% of year-end 2025 NAV, over seven months, fulfilling the stated goal of returning at least 50% of NAV by year-end 2026 ahead of schedule. No advisor named; watch continued distribution cadence and NAV erosion from portfolio repayments.
